description: This file provides gettext and locale handling functions for a Git-related project, including charset detection, preferred language retrieval, and gettext setup.

methods.name: get_preferred_languages
methods.description: Retrieves the user's preferred languages based on environment variables and locale settings.

methods.name: init_gettext_charset
methods.description: Initializes the charset for gettext based on locale.

methods.name: git_setup_gettext
methods.description: Sets up gettext environment for the project, including locale and text domain.

methods.name: gettext_width
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string in the current locale.

methods.name: is_utf8_locale
methods.description: Determines if the current locale uses UTF-8 encoding.
